title: Telepathic interview with a live ET at S4

tellings.quote: And he said he saw the ET guy, but he was like, you know, five and a half feet tall.

plain: A man named Oscar Wolf is said to have taken part in a telepathic interview with a living alien at S4, a secret site reported to lie near Area 51, the Air Force test base in Nevada, and to have seen the being, which he described as about five and a half feet tall. A guest named Dan Sheehan tells it on Michels' show as what Wolf told him, as a sign that the government holds live beings.
